sources.observation: The dark sandstone dome rises from the raised circular walkway. Pale rounded beams and square posts make up the two stone railings.

sources.credit: Rohit Sharma / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.observation: Three slightly curved carved crosspieces project beyond the two decorated piers. Round scroll ends, capitals and carved animals break up the silhouette.

limitations: The geometry covers Stupa No. 1 and its immediate gates and railings. Fine relief and individual decorative figures interpret the exterior photographs. The site scale uses the mapped outlines and the measured 36.6 m dome diameter.
